reviews.title: Trying to cancel was the real intelligence test
reviews.text: The IQ test was fun, but escaping the $12.99/week subscription was the REAL intelligence test! 😂 I took the test through a Facebook ad, NOT the App Store. I thought I paid $0.99 for my results, only to discover I’d started a 3-day trial that auto-renewed at $12.99/week. Because it was purchased through the website using Apple Pay, it didn’t appear in my Apple subscriptions. I had to contact the company directly to cancel, which they did promptly. Read that fine print!

reviews.title: YOU WILL LOVE THIS APP! TRY IT!
reviews.text: This is the funnest and most unique app of its kind that I’ve come across in a long time! The new games/challenges/experiences are really neat & exciting! They are a pleasant surprise to the brain; to the eyes! They are a breath of fresh air to ALL the senses and it feels wonderful ! I just love the variety and unexpected vast differences between older “brain games” and these new ones here! Made for the current times; It’s a whole new super cool & super fun experience! Worth every penny and worth your time and effort! You’ll finish up each time feeling a little smarter, feeling a little wiser, feeling the growth of your brain via its neuroplasticity but without feeling tired or exhausted at all! Instead you’ll feel energized and refreshed! Try it out! You won’t be disappointed!
